entries.text: 那么，牡丹同学，\n还有各位老大。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_01

entries.text: 有句话我要代表学院\n向天星队的各位说。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_02

entries.text: 真是太对不起你们了。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_03

entries.text: 身为学院校长，这是我克拉韦尔\n一生的过失……[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_04

entries.text: 天星队成立的理由……以及活跃的表现，\n我从各位老大那打听到了。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_05

entries.text: 自从我上任以来所看到的\n没有霸凌的学院风貌……[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_06

entries.text: 那是你们用悲伤、愤怒……\n以及勇气争取而来的。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_07

entries.text: ……先说我的结论。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_08

entries.text: 要求天星队解散，\n以及劝各位老大退学的话……\r\n我宣布立刻收回！[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_09

entries.text: 嗯！天星队不必解散了！！[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_10

entries.text: 太好了～！牡丹！\n以后大家也能继续在一起了！[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: team_0160_kakutou_03

entries.text: 可、可是……\n我背叛了大家……[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0160_botan_03

entries.text: 你是说星尘大作战的事？\n我听克拉韦尔校长说了。[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: team_0160_fairy_01

entries.text: 你是担心我们离不开天星队\n都快被退学了，才会那样做的吧？[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: team_0160_aku_01

entries.text: 而且我们也不是别人一句\n要我们解散就解散的乖孩子。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: team_0160_honoo_01

entries.text: 牡丹大人为吾等着想的这份心意\n何其深切，着实难以想象……[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: team_0160_doku_01

entries.text: 抱歉啊，让你担心了。\n我们已经没事了。[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: team_0160_kakutou_01

entries.text: ……我要继续说了。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_11

entries.text: 就像刚才说过的一样，\n我要收回让天星队解散的要求。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_12

entries.text: 然而，\n天星队的各位所犯下的……[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_13

entries.text: 长期无故旷课！\n乱改制服！[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_14

entries.text: 擅自拿走\n学院的备用品！[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_26

entries.text: 坐骑宝可梦的改造，\n以及飙车！[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_27

entries.text: ……等等、等等！\n各种违反校规的错误不能无视！[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_28

entries.text: 因此作为处分，\n我要请你们打义工。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_15

entries.text: 对，我要拜托\n天星队的各位营运ＳＴＣ。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_16

entries.text: Ｓ、Ｔ……这是什么的简称？[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0160_botan_06

entries.text: Ｓ是star，Ｔ是training，\nＣ是center的缩写。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_17

entries.text: ＳＴＣ，天星特训中心。\c\n由学院和宝可梦联盟\n为培养训练家而设立的全新设施！[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_18

entries.text: 这是在我看到[VAR 0x0100(0000)]同学\n到基地踢场时灵光一闪想出的点子。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_19

entries.text: 天星队的战术和基地\n都很特别，还很有独创性！[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_20

entries.text: 所以，基地会成为特训设施，\n天星队会成为ＳＴＣ工作人员，\r\n我会请大家继续展开活动。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_21

entries.text: ……我说完了，有什么问题吗？[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_22

entries.text: 呃，这好像很有趣。\n有点win-win的感觉……[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0160_botan_07

entries.text: 这话由我们来说会很怪，\n但牡丹，和我们一起干吧！[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: team_0160_fairy_02

entries.text: 正是……\n也请牡丹大人一起……[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: team_0160_doku_02

entries.text: 上下学也一起走吧！\n不管发生什么我们都会保护你的！[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: team_0160_kakutou_02

entries.text: 我们几个说过，\n如果能让天星队和上学的事\r\n两不误的话就再好不过了。[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: team_0160_aku_02

entries.text: 我觉得很好！
entries.label: team_0160_select_01

entries.text: 加油吧！
entries.label: team_0160_select_02

entries.text: 你不必现在就做决定。\n好好考虑一下吧。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_23

entries.text: 好了，\n我们暂时先解散吧。\r\n……不是说天星队，是说散场的意思！[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_24

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]同学，\n稍后能请你到校长室来吗？[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0160_head_teacher_25
